title: r1 major UX: five-field segment at 94 chars strains glanceability; width budget misallocated against glance priority
description: Evidence: statusline-data.md:37-42; the round-2 density dismissal (#359) leaned on these budgets discharging it. 94 chars data before separators; realistic line 110+. phase-answer — the headline — gets 20 while work-item/milestone get 24. Disposition: field-set question (demote session and/or work-item to the human form) is a contract-enumerated-fields change — Raise to SO; width re-balance is data-side. Owner: solution-owner (field set) with data-engineer (widths). Validator: ux.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21, round-1 triage): demote the session segment only. The session identifier leaves the glance surface (lowest glance value — the operator is IN the session; one 'crosslink session status' away in the human form). Work-item STAYS — the binding cue catches wrong-issue work. Freed width goes to the milestone segment at the fix pass, pairing with #680's width finding. Rejected: keep-all-five and demote-both. Amendment touch on the statusline field set + data-side width re-balance.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, statusline-data 0.2.0): session segment removed from display_fields (schema now pins exactly four glance fields); the demotion and its rationale stated in prose — the session renders in the human form, one crosslink session status away; freed width moved to milestone-with-count. Contract touch (statusline field set) rides #698. Round 2 re-verifies (validator: ux).
